name: 家庭点菜
install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh) && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd backend && uv sync && DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:////tmp/family-menu-dev.db IMAGE_STORAGE=memory ENVIRONMENT=development uv run python scripts/reset_sqlite_schema.py && cd ../frontend && npm ci

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd backend && DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:////tmp/family-menu-dev.db IMAGE_STORAGE=memory ENVIRONMENT=development uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: FastAPI on port 8000 (前端 Vite 代理 /api)

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Vite 开发服务器，浏览器访问端口 5173
